tei:div.tei:p: // lha chen tshangs pa'i gsol mchod phrin las kyi shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dbang mchog pad+ma'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo// lha chen tshangs pa la sger gsol byed na/ rin po che'i snod gas chag med pa'i nang du/ gtor ma rgyas par rnam sras khang brtsegs thog gsum/ 'khor sa rim gsum/ lcog brgyad dang bcas pa spyi 'gro ltar bca'/ bsdu na gtor ma dkar po gru bzhi pa la sde brgyad bshos bus bskor/ rgyas bsdus gang byed kyang gsang ba'i dam rdzas bsre zhing brgyan pa gnad che/ de'i mdun du ja chang 'o ma sha zan bur sbrang ka ra sogs zas sna bza' btung gi rigs ci 'byor ba bshams/ lha shing gi bsang dud phye mar sogs kyang 'dzoms par byas la/ de dag thams cad sngags drug phyag drug gam/ bsdu na yi ge gsum dang*/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du dur khrod chen po ro langs dang 'dab chags gcan gzan sna tshogs pas gang zhing mi ro rta ro la sogs pa gcal du bkram pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ tsaḥyig las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs thams cad bcom/ dregs pa can thams cad dbang du bsdus| de yongs su gyur pa las/ lha chen tshangs pa chen po dung gi thor tshugs can/ sku mdog dkar la dmar mdangs 'od 'bar zhing rab tu brjid pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba'i sku la dar dkar dang ras dkar gyi na bza' lhab lhub tu mnabs pa/ phyag g.yas shel dkar gyi gri ring rno ngar dang ldan pa bsnams pas dgra bgegs thogs pa med par rtsad nas gcod pa/ g.yon nyi zer gyi zhags pa bsnams pas dgra bgegs kyi ske nas bcing ste rab tu 'gug pa/ lha rta dkar po ngang zhur rin po che dang dar zab du mas brgyan pa la bcibs pa zhi ba'i nyams can/ de nyid drag por khros pa'i tshe/ sku mdog dmar po me ltar 'bar zhing spyan gsum mche gtsigs gnam lcags dang bse'i go khrab gyon zhing dar tshon sna tshogs nam mkhar 'phyo ba/ g.yas stag dong nyag phran gyis gang ba dang*/

g.yon du gzhu dang ral gri 'chang ba/ gnod sbyin dpa' bo rab tu khros pa'i cha lugs can/ de ltar zhi ba dang drag po'i sku la 'khor du bya dkar ze dmar klad la lding ba/ mi dkar thod dmar mdun du rgyug pa/ spre'u dkar gdong dmar 'bum gyis bskor ba/ snang srid 'jig rten dregs pa pho mo ma ning klu rgyud bzhis bsdus pa'i dkar po lha/ dmar po btsan/ nag po bdud/ klu dang drang srong*/ dam can sde bdun| dmu dang rā dza la sogs 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs sprin phung gtibs pa lta bus yongs su bskor ba thams cad kyang shin tu dpa' 'jigs rngam drag gtum pa'i rnam 'gyur can sprin dang rlung nag 'tshub ma'i nang na 'ur 'ur thug thug gi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar/ me'i rang bzhin glog stong 'khyug pa/ dgra bgegs thams cad kyi mi nor yul zhing khang khyim dang bcas pa skad cig la brlag cing*/ dam can sngags 'chang sgrub pa po'i sdong grogs skad cig la byed pa cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa ston pa'i mthu rtsal dang ldan pa/ gtso bo'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pa las/ rgya gar dur khrod rol pa'i gnas mchog nas bstan srung tshangs pa 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig la glog 'gyu ba ltar spyan drangs/ oṃ tsa pā la a shu tsa ṭi li dzaḥs ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ spos dang bsang dud rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ hūm̐ */ phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// lha chen tshangs pa bstan srung dam tshig can// skye 'gro'i srog la dbang byed ging chen po// dregs pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa da tshur byon// oṃ tsa pā la a shu tsa ṭi li dzaḥs ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ hoḥ dam ldan sngags 'chang gnas mchog 'dir// mkho dgu'i gtor mchod spyan gzigs bcas// 'dod yon kun ldan gnas 'di ru// mthun pa'i bstan la bde bar bzhugs// oṃ tsa pā la a shu tsa ṭi li dzaḥs ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/

zhes bzhugs su gsol/ hūm̐? */ lha chen dung gi thod ldan la// sngags 'chang mos pa 'du byed na// rtag tu 'go zhing grogs mdzad la// dgyes pa'i rnam rol bstan du gsol// oṃ tsa pā la a shu tsa ṭi li dzaḥ na mo na maḥ zhes phyag 'tshal/ lha rnams kyi mgo la rdo rje dang lce la bdud rtsi bzhag la/ hūm̐ */ sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma sogs/ */rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lhas// dam la bzhag pa dran mdzod la// de las ma 'da' sgrub pa po'i// bsam don bsgrubs la dam tshig srungs// oṃ tsa pā la a shu tsa ṭi li sa ma ya na rak+kan/ zhes dam la bzhag /hūm̐ */ lha chen tshangs pa 'khor bcas la// mthun pa'i dam rdzas mchod pa 'bul// 'dod yon me tog spos mar me// dri dang zhal zas rol mo dang*// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// sman raka gtor ma sha dang zan// mar thud shing 'bras sgog btsong spos// dkar gsum mngar gsum ja dang chang*// sna tshogs zas sna du ma dang*// khrab rmog gri mdung mda' gzhu mtshon// gos dar ras dang rta dre'u khyi// gnag phyugs la sogs dkor nor ni// mkho dgu ma tshang med pa dang*// dam rdzas tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*// lha shing bsang dud phye mar bcas// lha chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// thugs dam bskang phyir bzhes su gsol// oṃ tsa pā la a shu tsa ṭi li dzaḥs ma ya ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba ling+ta ga ṇa tsakra sarba kā ma gu ṇa pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes mchod pa 'bul/ hoḥ tshangs pa 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// khyod ni ye shes spyan mnga' bdag cag rnams// ma rig 'khrul blo nongs pa gang mchis pa// gnong zhing sems kyis mthol zhing bshags bgyid na// tshangs par mdzod la 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ tsa pā la a shu tsa ṭi li dzaḥs ma ya zhes pa'i mthar yig brgya brjod/ hūm̐ */ nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba// shel ging dkar po dregs pa yongs kyi gtso// slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' sdod mthu rtsal can// lha chen tshangs pa'i sku la bdag bstod do// zhi ba'i cha lugs rab dkar na bza' can// sku mdog dkar dmar zhi mdangs spyan gsum 'dzum// dkar po ngang ring mgyogs pa'i rta la zhon// mi mjed tshangs pa khyod la bdag bstod do// drag po'i skur bstan dmar po me ltar 'bar// zhub chen dpa' chas gnod sbyin khros pa'i tshul// rngam brjid stobs ldan dregs pa'i dmag dpon mdzad// yam shud dmar po khyod la bdag bstod do// 'khor bya spre'u mi ring sde brgyad tshogs// pho mo ma ning klu rgyud bzhis bsdus pa'i// dregs pa can kun mtsho la ngang pa ltar// sdud mdzad dung gi thor tshugs can la 'dud// ces bstod bzlas pa spro na/

tshangs pa'i thugs kar tsaḥyig la rang sngags kyis bskor ba bdag yi dam lha'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ tshangs pa'i thugs ka'i sngags sa bon dang bcas pa la phog pas/ thugs rgyud bskul bdag gis ci bcol ba'i las sgrub cing sdong grogs mdzad/ des 'khor thams cad las la bskul bas phrin las thogs med du sgrub par mos la/ oṃ tsa pā la a shu tsa tri li dzaḥ dzaḥ zhes gtso bo dang*/ oṃ tsa pā la a shu e tri ma phu a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhriṃ hriṃ/ zhes 'khor gyi sngags bzla/ mjug tu stegs gtsang ma'i khar gtor ma spags/ bza' btung thams cad kyi phud bran| sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/ hoḥ slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' sdod kun gyi gtso// lha chen tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can// 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba rnams// dgyes pa bskyed cing thugs dang mthun pa'i rdzas// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i// dam rdzas gtor ma 'dod dgu'i bza' btung bcas| |legs par 'bul gyis dgyes par bzhes su gsol// tshims shing rang bas bdag cag 'dod pa'i don// nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun sogs// tshe srog hur thum byad stems rbod gtong sogs// mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi zhing med par mdzod// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags sogs// dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel shing rgyas pa dang*| |khams gsum srid gsum mi nor zas gos sogs// pad+mar bung ba ji bzhin dbang du sdud// gnod byed dgra bgegs phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun// drag pos sgrol la ming yang med par mdzod// mdor na bdag gi bsam pa'i don thams cad// skad cig 'bad med nyid du 'grub pa sogs// bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod// ces gtor ma kho rang gnas phyogs su 'bul/ bskyed pa'i lha rnams rten yod na de la bstim/ med na rang gnas gshegs su gsol/

shis brjod bsngo smon bya'o// de ltar lha chen tshangs pa'i gsol mchod 'di'ang sngon chad mdor bsdus tsam zhig bgyis pa de nyid slar cung zad rgyas par byas pa ni/ 'bri gung pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas shing lug zla ba bzhi pa'i yar tshes bco lngar 'bri klung dbur stod rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu bris// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
